verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework, and a framework's CLI or tooling could plausibly include a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only agent-facing artifacts for external AI tools: a scaffolded AGENTS.md, Markdown versions of docs routes, and /llms-full.txt. Nothing documents an assistant inside Proa that a user can hand tasks to. The 'delegate' wording in proa-gh-1 refers to Markdown rendering, not AI delegation.
